$comment: Single source of truth for agent routing. Read by tools/validate-blueprints.mjs; the capability table in factory/AGENT_ROUTER.md is generated from it (node tools/router-table.mjs --write).

UI_HEAVY.notes: Lands shell + primitives before feature lanes

COMPLEX_DATA.triggers: >3 entities, relations, statuses with rules, approvals, history, money

SUPABASE.notes: Add supabase-engineer for storage, realtime, cron, SMTP or several environments (their own rows)

AUTH.triggers: Sign-in, invites, roles, admin-created accounts, SSO
AUTH.notes: SMTP and Auth URL config are part of it; a small app may let devops-engineer or database-engineer cover supabase-engineer

MULTI_TENANT.triggers: Several organizations/customers in one deployment; self-serve workspaces
MULTI_TENANT.notes: check-rls outsider cases mandatory; workspace switcher; self-serve = bootstrap --saas

BILLING.triggers: We charge our customers: plans, trials, subscriptions
BILLING.notes: Plan state gates writes (workspace_active); webhooks per environment

PROVIDER_DATA.triggers: We read customers' data from a provider (Stripe Connect, Google, banks)
PROVIDER_DATA.notes: Backfill + webhooks + reconcile; tokens never readable by authenticated

REALTIME.triggers: "live", see changes instantly, shared boards, chat

MOBILE_HEAVY.triggers: Most users on phones, camera, GPS, one-handed use
MOBILE_HEAVY.notes: Phone-first layouts, not a late pass

OFFLINE.notes: Outbox + replayable writes (client_id) + offline test script; pwa.offline read-cache or offline-queue

FILE_UPLOADS.notes: Bucket limits, path policies, signed URLs, compress phone photos

MESSAGING.notes: Template approval lead time: start early

EMAIL.triggers: Transactional email beyond auth, digests, documents by email

SCHEDULED_JOBS.notes: pg_cron + Vault (npm run db:cron); idempotent per period; schedule timezone explicit

REPORTING.notes: Pure engine, stored snapshots; PDFs via integration-engineer when delivered

CUSTOM_DOMAIN.triggers: A domain is named or implied

DOCS_HANDOVER.triggers: Company rollout, another team will operate it

SENSITIVE_DATA.triggers: Health, HR, finance, personal IDs, children, signatures
